article.title: Liberal Zionists are trying to distance themselves from the reality that Israeli voters overwhelmingly want genocide
article.author: Jonathan Ofir
article.content: Liberal Zionists bemoan both ultra-nationalist extremists and pro-Palestine activists, but Israel's latest elections show how they ultimately come to the defense of apartheid every time.
